moments.text: Infrared sensor view looking down on rippled sea, with a lighter glow around the crosshair and black redaction boxes at the edges.
The ripples briefly look sharper and more contrasty.
A tiny bright dot comes up from the lower right to just right of the crosshair and lingers there.
The dot moves out toward the right edge, then climbs to the upper right corner.
The dot slides left along the upper part of the frame and fades near the top centre.

notes: Dot is tiny and faint; many one-frame sea glints elsewhere.
